Re-measured at 24f92b0f744 after a rebase orphaned the previous stamp ba8fa548493; moved 409 -> 410, UP by one, and the unit is addons/social_media: efa247b26a9 '[ADD] social_media: add tests covering the res.company fields and view' gave the module its first tests (2 methods) and no lane in integration_tests.yml names it. Verified as a set with the current script in a detached worktree at ba8fa548493 (409 there): comm over the two sorted lists gives social_media on the right and nothing on the left, so no module gained coverage to hide behind. That commit came in through the rebase and never met this gate, which is why the floor sat below the tree. Banked rather than fixed because giving social_media a lane is a decision for integration_tests.yml, not a floor; it is worth 410 -> 409 the day it lands. Command: python tooling/architecture/module_suite_lane.py --count, as architecture.yml runs it.

412 -> 409, and every unit is a lane that already exists: hr_holidays, hr_work_entry and hr_work_entry_holidays each gained a suite in integration_tests.yml on 2026-08-30 and the floor was never banked with them. Verified as a SET, not as a count -- the current gate script run against a detached worktree at this floor's own measured_at (14a4cc97b07) lists 412 uncovered modules, the same script against HEAD lists 409, and comm over the two sorted lists gives exactly those three names on the left and NOTHING on the right, so no module lost coverage to pay for it.

Unchanged by this move: microsoft_account is still uncovered, so the previous note's stopgap stands on its own terms -- that entry was about a module with no lane, and this one is about three modules that got one. Giving microsoft_account a lane is still worth 409 -> 408 and is still that commit's author's to do.

Also unchanged by the 18 -> 25 lane split landed alongside this: the split redistributes existing --test-tags across more databases without naming a new module, and module_suite_lane reads --test-tags (line 83, 'a module's suite runs because a lane NAMES it'). Measured 409 before the split, after the split, and with and without the test_base_order manifest change.
